dedupe_keys.name: annual global cement production data by country robbie andrew cicero

description: This dataset collates annual cement production for every country for as long as possible, in thousands of tonnes. The Zenodo record says national statistical offices, cement associations and activity data in UNFCCC emissions reports take priority, with League of Nations, United Nations and USGS yearbooks filling gaps, some USGS values corrected, 1949 to 1989 USGS values back-calculated from CDIAC, Soviet states disaggregated before 1991, and national historical sources for France, Germany, Norway, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland and the United Kingdom reaching back to the 1870s and 1890s. It is maintained by Robbie Andrew of the CICERO Center for International Climate Research (release 260831, August 2026) under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as CSV with a per-value source file. Coverage is global. Caveats: blank cells mean no data, early totals may include natural cement, and sources differ by country and period. For simulation it gives long national series of cement output to model construction material supply, reconstruction demand and industrial energy use. Related catalogue records include the monthly global cement production data, GCP-CEM and the Global Cement and Concrete Tracker.
